answer: Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vault re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
